alerts.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 17 at 12:26PM PST until November 19 at 4:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, An increased risk for
sneaker waves and strong rip currents with breaking waves of
13 to 17 ft. For the High Surf Advisory, Large breaking
waves of 15 to 18 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes National
Seashore, San Francisco Peninsula Coast, Northern Monterey Bay
and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast Counties.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, through Wednesday
afternoon. For the High Surf Advisory, from 4 PM Wednesday to
4 PM PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without
warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks.
alerts.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.

Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 17 at 7:45AM PST until November 18 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...The Pacific Coast.

* WHEN...From 9 PM this evening to 1 PM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
alerts.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
